name: TDEX Provider
description: A liquidity provider holds Liquid reserves of both a BASE_ASSET-QUOTE_ASSET in his non-custodial Liquid hot-wallet, running automated market-making strategies, either with or without an oracle. Providers are incentivized to be always on and need to expose a public reachable endpoint either via clearnet or using an Onion hidden service.
short_desc: Provide liquidity on the TDEX Network, an open protocol to trade Liquid Network assets
author: TDEX Network
